concept.title: Gentle exercise that can be done seated
concept.shortdesc: As someone with limited mobility, I need exercise I can do sitting down, so that I stay active safely.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-036). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Who: older people, people with limited mobility, people with long-term conditions.
Situation: Many exercise classes assume standing; chair-based sessions exist.
A good result: Seated or low-impact classes with what to expect and any referral needed.
How much it matters: Convenience: a miss is an inconvenience, so the bar is lower.
